VAL_trade_routes_map_refresh_cache = {
	set_variable = { var = trade_occidia_map_frame value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = VAL_route_occidia_commissioned }
		}
		set_variable = { var = trade_occidia_map_frame value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = VAL_black_market_pressure value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
					check_variable = { var = VAL_corridor_security value = 3 compare = less_than }
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { var = trade_occidia_map_frame value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes
			check_variable = { var = VAL_black_market_pressure value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = VAL_corridor_security value = 3 compare = less_than }
		}
		set_variable = { var = trade_occidia_map_frame value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { VAL_trade_route_occidia_open = yes }
			has_country_flag = VAL_route_occidia_commissioned
		}
		set_variable = { var = trade_occidia_map_frame value = 4 }
	}
	set_variable = { var = trade_west_map_frame value = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { VAL_trade_route_west_open = yes }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = VAL_route_west_commissioned }
		}
		set_variable = { var = trade_west_map_frame value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			VAL_trade_route_west_open = yes
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					check_variable = { var = VAL_black_market_pressure value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }

			}
		}

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			VAL_trade_route_west_open = yes
			check_variable = { var = VAL_black_market_pressure value = 50 compare = greater_than_or_equals }
			check_variable = { var = VAL_corridor_security value = 3 compare = less_than }
		}
